component.name: Zerkalo
component.summary: Typst editor with live preview, LSP completions, and git sync

description.p: Zerkalo is a GTK4 editor for Typst documents with a focus on academic and contemplative writing. It embeds the Typst compiler directly — no external binary required — and renders a live preview as you type.

ul.li: Multi-file tabs with modified indicator and inline compile-error dots
Syntax highlighting, find and replace, auto-pair brackets
LSP completions via bundled tinymist — type # for a popup
Citation autocomplete — type @ for fuzzy BibTeX key search
Spell check with suggestions, Ignore All, and language selector
Word count, reading time, word-count goal, and session delta in the status bar
Command palette (Ctrl+K) — fuzzy search over commands and headings
Breadcrumb bar showing your heading path as the cursor moves
New from Template — dialog generates a complete Typst preamble
Import from LaTeX, DOCX, or PDF via pandoc
Export to PDF, HTML, DOCX, ODT, or LaTeX
Citation style switcher with GOST 7.32 support
Git sync — commit and push to all remotes in one click
File tree, citation panel, plan scratchpad, and section notes
Symbol insert panel for Cyrillic, Greek, Hebrew, and Sanskrit

description.p: Root chip now shows "Project Settings…": clicking the compilation root chip opens a popover with candidate root files and a Project Settings row at the bottom. Outline filenames moved to hover tooltip so section names are fully readable.

Fix live preview not updating while typing in a multi-file project: the debounced change handler was overriding the compilation root with the active tab on every keystroke. Also bumps flatpak runtime to GNOME Platform 50.

Fix crash when clicking files in a multi-file project (double-borrow panic in tab-switch handler). Fix compile button resetting the project compilation root on every tab switch. Fix tinymist, pandoc, git history, and pdftotext inside the flatpak sandbox.

Fix startup git warning in the flatpak (now checks via flatpak-spawn --host). Welcome window updated with current 0.12 features. GOST Type B font bundled in Kopilka, Rubric, and Zerkalo flatpaks so it is available to Typst documents and the UI font toggle inside the sandbox.

Template build system: templates are now real .typ files editable without touching Rust; user templates auto-load from ~/.config/zerkalo/templates/. New Chapter button creates a file and inserts #include in main.typ. Project Settings dialog for per-project root and bibliography. Cross-file outline shows headings from all project files.

Multi-file project system: New Project wizard with four templates (Blank, Essay, Journal/Thesis, Theological Journal), compilation root indicator (★) in the file tree, status bar root chip with quick-switch popover, collapsible directory rows, #include and #import insert helpers, and session-restore fixes for newly created projects.
Flatpak fixes: git sync now works via flatpak-spawn --host; Typst package cache (~/.cache/typst) is now accessible inside the sandbox.
Strip debug symbols from flatpak binaries to reduce package size.
Git Remotes dialog now includes a Primary Remote section for viewing and editing the origin URL.
